#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long solve(long long n, long long m) {
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    if (n == 1) {
        long long base = (m / 6) * 6;
        long long rem = m % 6;
        if (rem == 4) base += 2;
        if (rem == 5) base += 4;
        return base;
    }
    if (n == 2) {
        if (m == 2) return 0;
        if (m == 3) return 4;
        if (m == 7) return 12;
    }
    long long res = n * m;
    if (n % 2 == 1 && m % 2 == 1) res--;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << solve(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
